description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a code snippet exactly as provided, preserving indentation, symbols, spacing, and line breaks.

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output the code snippet exactly as provided, including indentation, quotes, braces, and semicolon.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the code matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
